build-history.sqlite:
CREATE TABLE terminal_builds (
                    build_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, image_id TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL,
                    updated_epoch REAL NOT NULL, finished_epoch REAL NOT NULL,
                    summary_json TEXT NOT NULL, payload_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL
                ) STRICT
metrics.sqlite:
CREATE TABLE metric_events (
                sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                timestamp_epoch REAL NOT NULL,
                kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                data_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                payload_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
            )

CREATE TABLE metric_store_meta (
                singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1),
                retained_events INTEGER NOT NULL,
                retained_payload_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL
            )
autoscaler-state.sqlite:
CREATE TABLE provider_operations (
                    operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    intent_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                    deployment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('sandbox', 'builder')),
                    state TEXT NOT NULL,
                    request_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    response_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    target_job_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    updated_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    last_error TEXT NOT NULL,
                    UNIQUE (deployment_id, kind, intent_key)
                )

CREATE TABLE operation_slots (
                    deployment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                    base_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                    incarnation INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    state TEXT NOT NULL,
                    updated_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY (deployment_id, kind, base_key)
                )

CREATE TABLE drain_intents (
                    deployment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    role TEXT NOT NULL,
                    token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                    state TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    updated_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY (deployment_id, job_id)
                )

CREATE TABLE image_state_v1_builds (record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, record_json TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT
